comment: artifact.c artifact_hit() 1626-1629, and uhitm.c mhitm_ad_phys() for its zero damage: a level-14 Valkyrie wishes for a -7 Vorpal Blade (so hits stay light), polymorphs into a freezing sphere (headless, with eyes), drops the blade and steps aside. A hostile gnome lord (neutral, so touch_artifact() lets it) picks the blade up and wields it, then attacks; blessed potions of full healing keep the sphere alive. When mhitu_dieroll is 1 the Vorpal Blade branch finds that the hero has no head: "Somehow, the gnome lord misses you wildly."
